overview_description.description: Deed’s SaaS platform makes it easy for employees to donate to their favorite charities and volunteer with good causes. HR and social impact teams at companies like Airbnb and Stripe use Deed to increase employee engagement and retention. It was founded by Deevee Kashi, Steven Liu, and Aske Ertmann, and has offices in Brooklyn, Berlin, Tel Aviv, and San Francisco.

about_short_description.short_description: Deed provides a social impact platform to connect people with causes and businesses with social impact.

product.name: Employee Giving
product.description: A platform feature that enables employees to pledge, give, and match donations to nonprofits and causes.

product.name: Employee Volunteering
product.description: A software solution that helps organizations manage and promote employee volunteer opportunities and programs.

product.name: Grants
product.description: A grant management tool that facilitates corporate grant applications, awards, and reporting to partner nonprofits.

product.name: Communities for ERGs
product.description: A platform feature that offers employee resource groups a dedicated space to organize and engage.

product.name: Actions
product.description: A feature that encourages employees to perform small acts of kindness and rewards them for participation.

product.name: Nonprofit Vetting API
product.description: An API service that verifies and vets nonprofits to ensure compliance and trustworthy engagement.
